summary.headline: EcoSimplex signs KRW 953m first-year Sudogwon landfill power/facility O&M contract (total KRW 24.7bn)
summary.what_happened: EcoSimplex Co., Ltd disclosed on Nov 24, 2026 that it signed a supply contract for the first phase of operation and management services for power generation and ancillary facilities at the Sudogwon Landfill with Sudogwon Landfill Corporation. The first-phase contract amount is KRW 953m (excluding VAT), against a total contract amount of KRW 24.7bn (excluding VAT) through Dec 3, 2028. The contract is paid on progress billings by period (quarterly).

summary.why_it_matters: Supply contracts of this type are typically disclosed to show a company's new order intake and its scale relative to recent revenue, and multi-year contracts are usually reported in phases, so the first-phase amount may not reflect the full value. Shareholders often look at the total contract value, payment terms and the counterparty's standing when assessing such filings.
